cards.title: How to Explain Adoption to a Child
cards.body: During National Adoption Month, helping children understand their adoption story is crucial for their emotional well-being. Parents can use age-appropriate language and honesty to support their child's understanding of their unique family journey.

cards.title: Stuck in a Rut: Escaping Unhelpful Cycles
cards.body: Children can get stuck in unhelpful mental and behavioral ruts, just like adults. A picture book explores the courage it takes to help kids break free from these patterns.

cards.title: Plan Family Dynamics Before Thanksgiving
cards.body: Anticipating uncomfortable conversations and setting realistic expectations can help make family gatherings manageable. Communicating what you need leaves room for genuine connection during the holidays.

cards.title: My Graduate Son Moved Back Home
cards.body: With economic pressures forcing graduates to return home, parents must adapt their parenting approach. Finding the balance between support and independence becomes key during this extended transition.

cards.title: School Dropouts and Youth Employment Crisis
cards.body: Around a third of persistently absent students in Years 10 and 11 go on to become NEET (not in education, employment or training). Understanding barriers to school attendance is crucial for tackling youth unemployment.
